WHAT EACH EMBEDDING BUYS. The four ESM blocks are not four independent costs: e*s and |e-s|
each need BOTH proteins embedded, so the compute question is not 'which blocks' but 'which
EMBEDDINGS'. Restricting the design space by what it forces you to embed:
no embeddings at all        0.5641   enz_seq + sub_seq
both sides embedded         0.6858   esm_enz + esm_sub + sub_seq
embedding the substrate side buys +0.0766, outside tau -- it is load-bearing and cannot be dropped.
ESM buys +0.1216 over counts and amino-acid composition alone, outside tau; the embedding stage is what carries this arm.

full 480, so absolute AUCs sit below the arm's published homology-disjoint number;

Space B has 58 groups. Its permutation resolution is reported rather than

outside the 218 A box, since those reactions were never dockable.
